$Comment: A Christmas Present: Present Thieves drop them and Elsie the Weaver sells them. It wears the game's red Christmas packet (Furniture_Christmas_Chest_Small_Red's model, texture, icon and icon framing) as a plain item with no BlockType, so it can never be placed as a block; Scale shrinks the block-sized model to fit a hand. Secondary opens it (Christmas_Present_Open): one present is spent, the table Christmas_Present_Gift pays out, and the opening counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Open. Primary gives it away (Christmas_Present_Give): pointed at another player it pays them the better table Christmas_Present_Given and puts Christmas Cheer on them, and the giver gets a little of Santa's favor and a USE_ITEM count with the Qualifier Gift; pointed at Tomas, Elsie, Bram or Santa it counts as that character's hand-in; pointed at nothing, at any other character or at a creature, it spends nothing. The item never checks the calendar, so a present kept from December still opens in March.
